title: Settings
telegramHint: Manage configs, peers and resolver from a Telegram bot. Only the admin ID can use the bot.
telegramTokenHintSet: Leave as-is to keep the current token, or paste a new one
telegramModePolling: Long polling (optional proxies for RU VPS)
telegramModeWebhook: Webhook (Telegram must reach the panel HTTPS URL)
telegramDailyReportHint: Sent to Telegram every day at 09:00 (panel timezone)
telegramProxiesHint: Add SOCKS5/HTTP proxies and/or resolver connections. The bot picks an available one (or the fastest).
telegramAddProxyHint: Enter a SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy URL. It will be checked against Telegram before adding.
telegramProxyAdded: Proxy OK ({ms} ms) — added to the pool. Save settings to apply.
telegramProxyAlreadyAdded: This proxy URL is already in the list
telegramDisableProxyConfirm: Disable proxy {url}? The bot will stop using it until you enable it again.
navChromeHint: Show or hide buttons in the header and mobile menu
publicIpDetectError: Could not detect the server public IP
publicIpHint: Panel IPv4; used in VPN Endpoint when no domain is selected
panelDomainHint: Example: vpn.example.com — A record must point to the public IP
panelDomainDnsHint: A record to the panel IP. HTTPS later needs an extra _acme-challenge TXT record in DNS (not only A).
httpsPortHint: Default 7443; used after the certificate is issued
timezoneHint: Used for dates and webhook timestamps in the panel
egressInterfaceHint: Used by sing-box and MASQUERADE inside the AWG container. Currently: {iface}
useDomainInEndpoint: Use domain instead of IP in VPN config Endpoint
redirectIpToDomainHint: Off by default: open the panel by IP or by domain. When on (and HTTPS is active), access via IP redirects to https://domain.
awgConfigsHint: AWG configs, server keys, and subnets are configured on the Configs page.
awgKernelHint: Needed for YouTube/Instagram ABR over full-tunnel + resolver, but not enough alone — also need working QUIC (Block QUIC off + XUDP) or a solid TCP path. After install, datapath must be kernel (not userspace). Official Amnezia packages only; on failure AWG keeps amneziawg-go.
awgKernelUninstallConfirmText: AWG will fall back to userspace amneziawg-go after restart. Configs and panel data are kept.
awgKernelMissingScript: Host helper script is missing. Re-run the awg-gui installer.
awgKernelStartError: Could not start kernel module operation
letsEncryptEmailHint: Required when issuing and renewing the certificate
acmeTxtHint: An A record to the panel IP is not enough for Let's Encrypt. You will also need a _acme-challenge TXT record (name and value are shown after Issue / Renew). Global DNS propagation can take up to an hour — the TXT value is kept for this domain until you abort or finish. After adding it, confirm issuance in the panel.
httpsAccessHint: Access: https://your-domain:{port} (port can be changed in the Panel tab).
pwaInstallHint: With HTTPS active, open the panel over https:// and install it as an app (header button, or the browser Install / Add to Home Screen menu). On iPhone/iPad: Share → Add to Home Screen.
addTxtRecord: Add a TXT record in DNS
txtKeepHint: These values are kept for the current domain — you can leave and come back later. Do not create a new record unless you click Abort.
twoFactorHint: Extra code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, etc.) at sign-in. If you lose access:
scanQrHint: Scan the QR in the app or enter the secret manually, then confirm with a code.
disable2faHint: Account password and app code are required so an attacker with an open session cannot remove protection in one click. Without this, disabling 2FA loses its purpose.
addTxtNotify: Add a TXT record in DNS
telegramLanguageHint: Language of bot messages and buttons
updateHint: Shows the installed version and lets you update the panel to the latest release without using the console.
upToDate: You are on the latest version
updateDownloadLogError: Failed to download the update log
updateClearLogConfirmText: This will erase the update journal on the server.
updateClearLogError: Failed to clear the update log
updateStuckHint: The update has been running a long time with no recent log activity. You can reset it and try again.
updateRetryStuckConfirmText: The stuck update will be marked failed and a new update attempt will start.
updateRetryStuckDone: Stuck update reset; new attempt started
updateRetryStuckError: Failed to retry the stuck update
updateUnavailable: Automatic update is available only for release-based installations.
updateConfirmText: The panel will download and apply the latest release. Services may restart briefly during the update.
reinstallConfirmText: The panel will download and reinstall version {version}. Services may restart briefly during the process.
